summary.text: Shane Dedrick, a Green Party candidate, lost the November 3, 2026 election for U.S. House in Michigan's 7th District to William Lawrence.
Dedrick advanced from the party's April 25, 2026 convention, and little biographical information is available in public sources.
Shane Dedrick received 1.3% of the vote to William Lawrence's 51.0%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
